comments.quote: 服務熱情周到，及早幫報備了車號，很順利開車到達，有停車位。老闆幫升級了房間，位置極佳，早晚看羣山雲海美極了！新開也業酒店，房間舒適，設備完好，裝修有特色，衞生很到位。早餐也很對胃口，總之很值。
comments.author: stoneda
comments.quoteEn: Warm and thorough service. They registered our number plate in advance so the drive in went smoothly, and there was a space. The owner upgraded our room, which had a superb position, and the sea of cloud over the ranges morning and evening was beautiful. The hotel is newly opened, the rooms are comfortable, everything works, the decoration has character and it is properly clean. Breakfast suited us too. Good value all round.

comments.quote: 服務不錯，早餐品種有待提高，風景還可以，比較適合帶小朋友。有點像民宿的感覺，房間面積蠻大的，老闆也很熱情
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: 位置絕佳，早餐也不錯，看出老闆很用心，全程指導我們怎麼上山下山，怎麼遊玩兒。窗外的無敵景色附上就能説明一切哈哈，比觀景台的景色還美。
comments.author: Guest User
